ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)

   B. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
